title: Finance Head
description:
**Hi**  
**We are Hiring!!**

**Position:** Finance Head  
**Experience:** 15+ yrs (Atleast 6+ yrs in construction/Real Estate industry)

**Location:** Ernakulam / Kochi, Kerala

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Finance & Accounts

**Reporting To:** Chief Executive Officer / Managing Director / Board of Directors

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and high-performing financial leader to join as **Head of Finance** at our Corporate Head Office in Ernakulam. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the complete financial planning, budgeting, project funding, risk management, regulatory compliance, and fiscal governance for our real estate portfolio.

As a key strategic partner to the senior leadership team, you will drive business profitability, structure optimal capital solutions for luxury real estate developments, and lead a dedicated team of finance and accounting professionals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership & Planning**

* Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with the company’s expansion and growth vision in the real estate sector.
* Lead annual budgeting, long-term forecasting, capital allocation strategies, and cash flow modeling across all active and upcoming real estate projects.
* Evaluate financial feasibility, land acquisitions, joint ventures (JVs), and return on investment (ROI) for prospective project launches.

**2. Project Finance, Capital Raising & Treasury**

* Manage bank relationships, securing project finance, term loans, working capital limits, and equity funding at optimal rates.
* Structure structured debt solutions, non-banking financial company (NBFC) funding, and strategic financial partnerships.
* Optimally manage corporate liquidity, project cashflows, escrow accounts, and debt servicing to ensure operational continuity.

**3. Real Estate Compliance & Financial Governance**

* Ensure strict adherence to **RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Authority)** financial norms, including designated escrow accounts management, project fund utilization, and quarterly filings.
* Manage direct and indirect tax planning and filings, including **GST** for real estate, Income Tax, TDS, and property-related statutory obligations.
* Oversee statutory audits, internal controls, corporate governance, and ensure error-free financial reporting as per Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS).

**4. Team Leadership & Financial Operations**

* Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing finance and accounting team with a focus on accountability and operational excellence.
* Direct monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements preparation, trial balances, P&L accounts, and balance sheet finalizations.
* Optimize enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP / Oracle / real-estate specific ERPs) to automate financial reporting and reporting dashboards for management decision-making.

**Eligibility Criteria & Qualifications**

· Candidates with **Chartered Accountant (CA) or CMA** or **MBA or M.com in Finance or any other relevant degree** from a premier institute will also be considered

· Minimum **10+ years** of progressive post-qualification experience in core accounting & finance functions.

· Minimum **4–5 years** in a leadership or managerial role managing teams and directly interacting with C-suite stakeholders/banks.

description:
**Job Title: Accounts & Finance Manager – BPO Client Services**

**Location:** Kakkanad, Kochi  
**Reports to:** Head of Finance / Senior Management

**Role Overview:**

The Accounts & Finance Manager – BPO Operations will be responsible for end-to-end financial management and accounting for a portfolio of international clients, primarily serving organizations in KSA, Bahrain, Oman, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, China, and other regions. This role ensures the seamless delivery of Finance and Accounts services as per each client’s requirements, legal frameworks, and best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Act as the key accounts & finance point of contact for assigned BPO clients across countries.
* Oversee and manage all aspects of end-to-end client finance operations, including accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, reconciliations, invoice processing, payroll accounting, taxation, and statutory compliance.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of financial reports, client MIS, budgets, forecasts, variance analyses, and management accounts tailored to each client.
* Coordinate and facilitate external audits and ensure audit readiness for client portfolios; respond to client and auditor queries promptly.
* Stay up to date with regulatory/tax changes in key client markets (KSA, Bahrain, Oman, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, China, etc.) and ensure full compliance for each account.
* Implement, document, and refine accounting policies, financial controls, and procedures for client operations as per international standards and local regulations.
* Handle internal controls, risk management, fraud prevention, and cash management for client entities.
* Liaise with client leadership and internal cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery and address queries/escalations.
* Support clients in financial planning, treasury, funding requirements, and process improvement initiatives.
* Oversee digital tools (ERP/finance modules), data integrity, and process automation for efficient workflows.
* Manage a team of accountants as required, provide mentorship, and ensure ongoing skills development.
* Generate ad hoc financial analyses and reports as requested by the client.

**Requirements:**

* Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce (CA/ACCA/CPA/CMA or equivalent preferred).
* 7+ years of progressive accounting & finance experience, including at least 2 years in a BPO/shared services environment or client-facing role.
* Deep knowledge of accounting practices, IFRS/local GAAP, and statutory compliance in GCC markets (KSA, Bahrain, Oman, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait) and working knowledge of China financial regulations.
* Experience handling accounts & finance for multiple international clients.
* Excellent client communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficient in accounting ERPs (SAP/Oracle/Tally/QuickBooks or similar) and MS Office.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management abilities.
* High attention to detail, ethical standards, and data accuracy.
* Flexibility to collaborate across different time zones as necessary.

Pay: Up to ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Job Title: Finance Controller & Manager – Projects & Operations

**Company:** Western Group of Companies  
**Industry:** Oil & Gas, Shipbuilding, Marine Engineering, EPC & Infrastructure Projects  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 8–12 years preferred  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and analytical **Finance Controller & Manager – Projects & Operations** to oversee the company's complete finance and accounting functions while providing strategic financial insights to management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for cash flow management, Profit & Loss (P&L) analysis, budgeting, financial forecasting, project cost control and management MIS reporting. The candidate must possess strong expertise in advanced Microsoft Excel, financial modelling and project-based financial management, preferably in Oil & Gas, EPC, shipbuilding, marine engineering or infrastructure industries.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete finance and accounting functions, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliation, journal entries and monthly financial closing.
* Prepare, review and analyse monthly and project-wise Profit & Loss statements, balance sheets and cash flow statements.
* Monitor daily cash flow, working capital, fund requirements, receivables, payables and payment schedules.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and financial projections to support business planning and management decisions.
* Prepare and submit monthly, weekly and project-wise MIS reports, financial dashboards and performance summaries to senior management.
* Monitor project budgets against actual expenses, identify cost overruns and analyse project profitability.
* Prepare budgetary plans, financial forecasts, variance analysis and cost-control reports.
* Track project revenue, expenses, commitments, outstanding payments and collections in coordination with project, commercial and procurement teams.
* Analyse financial data using advanced Microsoft Excel to identify trends, financial risks, inefficiencies and opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Ensure timely GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable statutory compliance in coordination with the relevant teams and consultants.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records.
* Establish effective financial controls, accounting procedures and reporting systems across projects and operations.
* Provide management with actionable financial insights, profitability assessments and recommendations for improving financial performance.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* CA / CMA / MBA Finance or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in finance and accounts, preferably in a project-oriented organisation.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements, taxation, budgeting and financial reporting.
* Experience in cash flow management, P&L analysis, working capital management and project cost control.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, complex formulas, dashboards and financial modelling.
* Experience in preparing management MIS reports and presenting financial performance to senior management.
* Working knowledge of accounting software or ERP systems.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:

* Oil & Gas and EPC projects
* Shipbuilding, ship repair and marine engineering
* Pipeline and infrastructure projects
* Civil construction and other project-based industries

Key Skills

* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* Cash Flow Forecasting and Management
* Profit & Loss Analysis
* Complete Accounts Management
* Project Cost Control and Profitability Analysis
* Budgeting and Financial Forecasting
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and Financial Modelling
* Management Information Systems (MIS)
* Working Capital Management
* Statutory Compliance and Audit Coordination
* Analytical Thinking and Management Reporting

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, commercially aware and capable of independently managing the finance and accounts function while providing accurate, timely and meaningful financial reports to management. The candidate must have strong analytical skills, advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights.

**Candidates with strong experience in project-wise financial monitoring, cash flow planning and management reporting in Oil & Gas, EPC or shipbuilding organisations are strongly encouraged to apply.**

title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
Blue Tech Marine Services PVT LTD, a part of Bluebird Group, is currently seeking a diligent and detail-oriented **Accounts Executive** to join our Finance and Accounts team in Kochi. The role will cover day-to-day accounting operations, ERP coordination, cash and bank transactions, reconciliations, receivables, and maintenance of accurate financial records through to account finalisation.

**Educational Qualification:** Commerce graduate preferred; working knowledge of ERP software required

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Ø ERP coordination and system support: Coordinate with ERP service providers to report issues, follow up on resolutions, support system configuration or process improvements, and help ensure the ERP system meets the company’s accounting and reporting requirements.

Ø Accounting entries and ledger maintenance: Record and review day-to-day financial transactions, maintain general ledger and subsidiary ledgers, and ensure entries are supported by appropriate documentation and posted to the correct accounts and periods.

Ø Invoicing and billing support: Prepare, verify, record, and track customer and supplier invoices, as applicable; check supporting documents and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve billing discrepancies.

Ø Accounts receivable and collections: Monitor outstanding receivables, follow up on overdue payments with customers and internal teams, update collection status, and escalate long-pending or disputed items to the appropriate supervisor.

Ø Petty cash management: Maintain petty cash records, verify bills and vouchers, record approved expenses, monitor balances, and ensure timely submission and replenishment requests in line with company procedures.

Ø Bank and account reconciliations: Prepare regular bank reconciliations and reconcile relevant ledger balances, investigate unmatched entries or discrepancies, and follow up for timely resolution.

Ø Payments and expense processing: Assist with payment preparation, expense verification, employee claims, supplier balances, and other routine accounting activities, ensuring appropriate approvals and supporting documents are available before processing.

Ø Cash and bank transaction tracking: Maintain accurate records of receipts, payments, deposits, and transfers; verify entries against bank statements and supporting records.

Ø Month-end and year-end support: Assist with closing activities, schedules, balance confirmations, reconciliations, and preparation of records required for account finalisation, audit, and statutory or management reporting.

Ø Financial data accuracy: Enter and update financial information in the ERP and related records promptly, maintain organised documentation, and protect the confidentiality and integrity of financial data.

Ø Reports and analysis: Prepare periodic reports on receivables, payables, expenses, cash and bank balances, reconciliations, and other financial information required by management.

Ø Internal coordination: Liaise with Finance and Accounts colleagues, operations, sales, procurement, and other departments to obtain documents, clarify transactions, and resolve accounting-related queries.

Ø Compliance and controls: Follow company accounting procedures, approval workflows, record-retention practices, and applicable financial control requirements; promptly highlight unusual transactions or discrepancies.

Ø Additional duties: Undertake other accounting and finance-related responsibilities reasonably assigned by the reporting manager, according to business requirements.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Ø Minimum 2 years of experience working with ERP applications.

Ø Good understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, and reconciliation practices.

Ø Working knowledge of MS Excel, including the ability to maintain schedules and prepare reports.

Ø Practical understanding of petty cash, bank reconciliation, invoicing, and receivables is an advantage.

Ø Strong numerical accuracy, analytical thinking, organisation, and attention to detail.

Ø Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.

Ø Ability to manage deadlines, maintain confidentiality, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and external service providers.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 2 years (Required)
* Accounting: 2 years (Preferred)

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744627

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Role Title:** GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst

**Alliance:** Microsoft

**Competency:** Co-Investments

**Function:** GDS ES Growth & Innovation

**Rank:** Supervising Associate

**Sub Function:** GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE

**The opportunity**

Microsoft is one of EY’s most strategic alliance relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. Within this context, the Co-Investment team plays an important role in bringing structure, governance and execution discipline to investments that support joint growth priorities with Microsoft.

The GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst will support the Microsoft Co-Investments team by coordinating investment governance, funding administration, portfolio visibility, reporting, stakeholder follow-through and outcome tracking across global and regional initiatives.

This role is suited to a structured, commercially aware professional who can translate investment priorities into practical execution support. The incumbent will work with Microsoft Alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional alliance teams, solution area leads, finance, commercial, sales, marketing and GDS teams to help ensure co-investment activities are planned, governed, tracked and activated with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

The role will also contribute to AI-led investment priorities across Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, automation and emerging Microsoft solution areas by supporting structured assessment, tracking and reporting of business value, responsible AI considerations and commercialization readiness.
